row.name: As We Grow Learning Center - East

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: A caregiver used an object to hit a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: Three caregivers did ot have CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: The operational polices did not have information on Parent Rights.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §746.501(a)(20))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Procedures parents access minimum standards online, TX A/N hotline, and HHSC website: The operation did not have the most updated information on how parents can access the Minimum standards online or the HHS web site.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Procedures parents access minimum standards online, TX A/N hotline, and HHSC website (26 TAC §746.501(a)(23))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - in Front of Access and on Sides: The play structure's did not have a use zone of six feet, the play structure  is only 3 ft and 3 inches from the barrier.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - in Front of Access and on Sides (26 TAC §746.4805(a))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: Three caregivers did not have first aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: One caregiver with a hire date of 2/5/24 was missing 20 hours of training for training year 2/5/24 to 2/5/25. One caregiver with a hire date of 7/24/23 was missing 8 hours of training for training year 7/24/23 to 7/24/24. One caregiver with a hire date of 5/1/24 is missing 3 hours of training for training year 5/1/24 to 5/1/25.      Corrected:  When using 20 hours of training for training year 2/5/25 to2/5/25, using 8 hours for training year 7/24/25 to 7/24/26 and using 3 hours for training year 5/1/25 to 5/1/26.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The play strructure on the playground had broken parts.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: The caregiver did not intervene when a child was seen choking from a string wrapped around their neck.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: A caregiver was using a cell phone while tasked with supervision of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: The operation did not provide an incident report when a parent made an allegation that a child was place at risk.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: The operation failed to make a report when a child was placed at risk.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary: During the follow-up inspection it was observed that sippy cups, a jug of milk, and a box of crackers, were all sitting on the changing table while the caregivers passed out snack and filled up the children's sippy cups. This was corrected at inspection when the caregivers were asked to move the snack supplies onto a shelf rather than the changing table, and they did.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary (26 TAC §746.3317)

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: During the inspection it was observed that a child's diaper was changed and the caregiver did not wash their hands afterwards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily: During the investigation inspection it was found that the operation was not able to show records that they have been conducting their daily or monthly inspections to ensure the safety of the building and grounds for the children present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily (26 TAC §746.4751(a))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area: During the inspection it was observed that the changing pad was not sanitzed between each diaper change.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3505(e))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: During the inspection it was observed that 4 infants were having screen time, using their caregiver's tablet, sitting in highchairs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Operation Open to Parents At All Times: During the inspection it was observed that parents were not being allowed access into the main part of the operation while picking up their children. They were stopped in the front office and their children were brought out to them.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Operation Open to Parents At All Times (26 TAC §746.201(7))

occurrences.finding: Location of Handwashing Sink: During the inspection it was observed that the toddler sink was not equipped with soap and the school age toilet was not equipped with toilet paper.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Location of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.4405)

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Removing Gloves: During the inspection it was observed that a caregiver removed their gloves after changing a diaper and did not wash their hands before moving on to the next child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Removing Gloves (26 TAC §746.3415(13))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During the investigation it was found that the operation had been deficient in supervision when caregivers were unaware of some of the school age children's behaviors and actions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: During the inspection dead roaches were observed in the building and garbage was observed on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During the investigation it was found that the operation is sometimes out of compliance with state required caregiver to child ratios. One caregiver will be left responsible for a higher number of children than they should have by themselves. This has occurred with the infants, toddlers, and school age children at different times in the past month.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly: During the investigation it was found that there was a 2-3 day period in February 2025 in which the operation did not have their air conditioner running and this caused the operation to be too hot inside for ideal and/or safe conditions for the children present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly (26 TAC §746.3407(10))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: During the investigation inspection it was found that the operation had a broken toilet lid, with broken porcelain, accessible to the children in care. It was also found that the changing table in the infant room has a broken strap and is unstable, causing the potential of a baby sliding off. In it's current state, it is not suitable for use and presents a safety hazard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During the inspection it was observed that the infants had one caregiver with seven infants present. This classroom was over ratio by two infants. It was also observed that there was one caregiver with 12, two year olds. This classroom was over ratio by one toddler.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: During the follow-up inspection it was observed that a classroom with children under the age of two were having screen time on the caregiver's cell phone.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: During the follow-up inspection an infant was observed sleeping in a bouncer seat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: During the inspection it was observed that a caregiver changed a child's diaper and then sat them at the table and served them a cup of milk without washing their hands or the child's hands first.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: During the inspection it was observed that a classroom with children under the age of two were watching a children's show on the classroom's tablet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Location of Toilets: During the inspection it was observed that the toilet in the toddler classroom was not equipped any toilet paper as required for independent use.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Location of Toilets (26 TAC §746.4409)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: There are photographs that show pests in the director's office.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Parent Provided Meals/Snacks - Statement on Enrollment Agreement: There was no proof that there was a written agreement between the parent and operation that food would be brought from home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parent Provided Meals/Snacks - Statement on Enrollment Agreement (26 TAC §746.3309(a))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: The first aid kit was incomplete on the transportation van. The kit was missing tweezers and a thermometer. The first aid kit in the building was missing tape. Note:corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Supplies Not Expired: There were 3 expired aspirin observed in the kit. Note:corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Supplies Not Expired (26 TAC §746.4003(b))
